title: Dorms/theater
content: just found this sub! it's amazing to see so much that resonates. I dream of a movie theater that is part of a dunkin donuts. the theater is red and gold, just like the mall outside. I'm always ordering a coffee or drinking it while I look at the titles of what's playing. but I never go see a movie. for me the mall is an outdoor mall plaza. it's connected to some university dorms that I stay at. there's a kitchen where students work, and down the hall is my room. the ceilings are really tall, and the walls are dark purple in the room. I worked at the university kitchen briefly, but the last couple of times I've gone here I've been getting coffee in one of the mall shops, and I'm aware that I have a different job though I'm not sure what it is. there's also one of those silver trains that go over the mall plaza. like an above ground subway.
